# `scope_set_track_mode`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Select the mount tracking mode by name.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x714d0 (64-bit build) |

Passes the supplied mode string to the mount tracking-mode setter, which changes the tracking rate or mode. The handler has no enum, range or default; the allowed names are compared by the selected mount driver and are not established. Success means the call returned. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay. Mount serial (firmware 9.31, READ): :TQ (sidereal), :TS (solar), :TL (lunar).

Side effects: Changes the mount tracking rate or mode.
